licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets cleanly partition the data by grouping license-procurement fraud and false statements together, separating out criminal convictions, clinical negligence/incompetence, substance misuse impairing practice, non-substance physical/mental disability, the broad catch-all of sexual misconduct/fee-splitting/improper solicitation/patient exploitation, controlled-substance prescribing/distribution offenses distinct from personal impairment, false or deceptive advertising as its own recurring category, and the large residual of compliance failures (board orders, record-keeping, reporting duties, continuing education, supervision) under regulatory/administrative violations.

profession_specific.board_certification_.rationale: The items cluster tightly around three named national boards (ABFAS, ABPS, ABPM), one umbrella accreditor (CPME), and a residual group of generic or state-deferred references, covering the full distribution without inventing empty buckets.
